records.section: Completing the PHS Assignment Request Form
records.statement: The form is optional. Applicants may make a single entry and do not need to complete every field or section.

The information is used to communicate assignment and review preferences to referral and scientific review staff; it is not part of the assembled application and is not provided to program staff or reviewers.

Applicants may enter up to three short awarding-component abbreviations. Suggestions must identify participating organizations in the funding opportunity or be supported by an appropriate Notice of Special Interest in R&R Cover Form box 4B.
Applicants may enter up to three scientific review group or special-emphasis-panel codes and should remove hyphens, parentheses, and spaces. Free-form descriptions should not be entered.
Applicants may explain why their awarding-component or study-section suggestions are appropriate. The response limit is 1,000 characters.
Applicants may enter up to five areas of expertise, limited to 40 characters each, and must not enter names of individuals they would like to review the application.

Applicants may identify individuals who should not review the application, explain why, and provide enough identifying information such as name and organizational affiliation. The response limit is 1,000 characters.

knownSourceConflict.detail: The Grants.gov readonly PDF uses the illustrative study-section code B10 while the pinned DAT uses BP10. This normalized instruction capture does not resolve that conflict, and the declarative help omits the disputed example.
